behavior: Click 'Open file' on the Recents page to pick one or more PDFs; they are held and the Tools page opens with a 'Choose a tool for your file' toast.
limits: Only PDFs are offered by the dialog; images or Office files cannot be opened from Home.

behavior: Drop a PDF anywhere on the window while on Home; it is kept and the Tools page opens so you pick a tool.
limits: Non-PDFs dropped on Home are refused with 'Open a tool first to add …'.

feature: Drop files on a tool tab
behavior: Drop a file on the window while a tool tab is active; it is added to that tool if the extension is accepted.
Dropping a file a tool does not accept shows 'Not supported by <tool>: <name>'.
Dropping a folder shows 'Folders cannot be added: <name>' instead of adding its contents.
limits: No recursive folder import.

feature: Home files carried into the tool
behavior: After opening PDFs from Home, clicking a tool opens it preloaded with the held files it accepts.
limits: Held files the tool does not accept are dropped silently.

behavior: Click 'Open file' in an empty tool tab to get a file dialog filtered to that tool's extensions; multi-file tools allow several.
Click the round red '+' (with file count badge) in a tool tab to add more files.
The add-files dialog opens in the folder of the last file added to the tab.
limits: Not remembered across tabs or sessions.

behavior: On a single-file tool, adding a new file replaces the current one.

feature: Remove a file from the grid
behavior: Hover a file card and click × to remove it from the tool.
Hover a file card in a multi-file tool and click ← or → to move it one place.
limits: No drag-and-drop reordering of file cards; one step at a time.

behavior: Each added file shows a page-1 thumbnail with size and page count ('3.17 MB - 7 pages').
A protected file shows a lock badge on its card.
A file whose preview crashed stays with '⚠ preview unavailable'.
Adding a protected PDF opens a '<file> is password protected' dialog; type the password and press Enter or Unlock.
A wrong password shakes the dialog, clears the field and shows 'Wrong password'.
Click Skip in the password dialog to leave that file out.
Several protected files queue; the dialog asks for each in turn.
limits: No 'use this password for all' option.

behavior: A PDF that cannot be opened is removed with a 'Cannot open <name>: <error>' toast.
In Repair, a file that cannot be previewed stays with 'Can't preview — will try to repair'.
Errors, rejections and hints appear as a bottom-centre toast for 3 seconds.
limits: No toast history; messages disappear after 3 s.

behavior: Each opened tool gets its own tab with icon and name; click a tab to switch, its options survive switching.
limits: No keyboard shortcut to switch or close tabs.

behavior: Click the Home tab to go back to Recents/Tools/History/Preferences.
Click + in the tab bar to return to the Tools page and pick another tool.
Click × on a tab to close it.
limits: No Cmd+W.

behavior: Closing a tab with a running job asks 'A task is still running' with Keep or Cancel job.
If the tab was closed while a job ran on, the result is still recorded and a '<tool> finished: <file>' toast appears.
Click Recents, Tools, Tasks History or Preferences in the left sidebar.
Below 1000 px wide the sidebar shows icons only.
Recents lists up to 12 recent output files with thumbnail, size, pages and age.
limits: Recents are outputs of Sheaf jobs only, not files merely opened.

behavior: Click a recent card to open the file in the default app.
limits: Opens externally; Sheaf has no reader view of its own.

behavior: Hover a recent card and click the folder icon to show it in Finder/Explorer.
With no recents, an illustration and 'Your recent files will appear here' show.
Recents whose file no longer exists are hidden on refresh.
Window opens at 1280×800 with a 900×600 minimum.
The Tools page shows 28 tool cards under six collapsible categories.
Click a category heading to collapse or expand its tools.
limits: Collapse state is not saved between launches.

behavior: Use the Sort dropdown to switch between grouped categories and one flat grid.
limits: No alphabetical sort, no favourites.

behavior: Click a tool card to open it in a new tab.
(Not implemented) there is no search box to filter tools.
limits: No tool search field.

behavior: Each tool has a coloured tile with a Lucide icon, reused on its tab.
Add two or more PDFs and click Merge PDF to combine them in the shown order.
limits: Needs at least 2 files; no per-file page ranges.

behavior: Hover a file and use ← / → to set the merge order.
limits: No drag reordering.

behavior: Type an 'Output file name'; .pdf is added if missing.
Choose 'Split by range' and type ranges like 1-3,5,8-10 to get one file per range.
Choose 'Split every N pages' and set pages per file with the −/+ stepper.
limits: Stepper has no typed entry; no split by size or bookmarks.

behavior: Split asks for a folder and writes the parts there.
Type pages to remove ('1-3,5') and run Remove pages.
limits: Pages are typed, not picked visually.

behavior: Type pages to extract and run Extract pages to get a new PDF.
limits: One output only; no 'each page a separate file' option.

behavior: An info box explains '2,4-6 means pages 2, 4, 5 and 6'.
Open Organize to see every page as a thumbnail card.
limits: Single PDF only; cannot combine pages from several files.

feature: Reorder pages with arrows in Organize
behavior: Hover a page and click ← / → to move it one place.
limits: No drag-and-drop of thumbnails despite the catalogue description; no multi-select.

behavior: Hover a page and click × to drop it.
Click 'Insert blank page' to append a blank page at the end.
limits: Blank page is always added at the end, then moved with arrows.

behavior: (Not implemented) the catalogue says 'duplicate' but there is no duplicate control.
limits: No duplicate action in the UI; only CLI --order can repeat a page.

behavior: (Not implemented) Organize has no per-page rotate.
limits: Per-page rotation only through Rotate's page field.

behavior: If page thumbnails fail, '⚠ Page previews unavailable' shows.
Choose 90°, 180° or 270° clockwise and run Rotate PDF on one or more PDFs.
limits: No counter-clockwise button (CLI only via negative degrees); no visual preview.

behavior: Type pages in 'Pages (optional)' to rotate only those.
Add several PDFs to Rotate to process them all at once.
Pick Extreme, Recommended or Low compression and run Compress.
limits: Only image recompression; fonts and vectors untouched.

behavior: Extreme downsizes images to 1000 px long side at JPEG quality 50.
Recommended downsizes to 1600 px at quality 70 (default).
Low downsizes to 2400 px at quality 85.
Add several PDFs to compress them all.
If compressing does not help, the original bytes are copied and the result says it is already as small as it gets.
The result shows size before → after and '% smaller!'.
limits: No target size or custom DPI/quality.

behavior: Compressing a protected PDF warns the output is not password-protected, and says if the copy grew.
Add damaged PDFs and run Repair to rebuild them.
Run OCR to add an invisible searchable text layer to scanned pages.
Tick document languages in the OCR panel.
limits: Only English is listed (pdfcraft LANGUAGES = [en]); the job uses only the first ticked language; Latin script only.

behavior: Tick 'Also read pages with text' to OCR pages that already have text, adding only new words.
If the models are missing, the panel warns and the button stays disabled.
The result reports pages read, words added and pages that already had text.
limits: No deskew, no output as image-only PDF.

behavior: Add JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF or BMP images and run JPG to PDF to get one PDF.
limits: One combined PDF only; no one-PDF-per-image option.

behavior: Use ← / → on image cards to set page order.
Choose 'Fit to image' so each page matches its image.
Choose 'A4 portrait' to centre each image on an A4 page.
limits: No Letter or other paper sizes.

behavior: Choose 'A4 landscape'.
For A4, pick margin None, Small (18 pt) or Big (36 pt).
Add .doc/.docx/.odt/.rtf and convert to PDF through LibreOffice.
limits: Requires a separately installed LibreOffice.

behavior: Add .ppt/.pptx/.odp and convert through LibreOffice.
limits: Requires LibreOffice.

behavior: Add .xls/.xlsx/.ods/.csv and convert through LibreOffice.
limits: Requires LibreOffice; no sheet or print-area choice.

behavior: Add .html/.htm files and render them as PDF through LibreOffice.
limits: Local files only, no URL input; requires LibreOffice.

behavior: Without LibreOffice the panel says to install it and offers 'Get LibreOffice' opening the download page.
Info box: 'Converted with LibreOffice on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.'
Each Office conversion times out after 120 s.
Several documents convert in one run; failed ones are listed on the result page.
Export every page as JPEG into a chosen folder.
limits: JPEG only (no PNG/TIFF output in the app); all pages, no range.

behavior: Normal quality = 150 dpi, JPEG 85.
High quality = 300 dpi, JPEG 92.
Export a PDF to an editable .docx.
limits: Layout is approximate.

behavior: Export a PDF to .pptx, one slide per page.
limits: Layout is approximate.

behavior: Recover tables from a PDF into .xlsx.
limits: Table detection is heuristic; text outside tables goes in column A.

behavior: Choose 'One sheet' to put all tables on one sheet.
Choose 'Multiple sheets' for one sheet per table.
Choose 'OCR (scanned PDFs)' to read scanned pages before export to Word/PowerPoint/Excel.
limits: Same English/Latin-only OCR.

behavior: Choose 'No OCR (text PDFs)' (default).
Info box warns that exact formatting may differ.
Convert to the archival PDF/A format and check the result.
Choose PDF/A-2b (recommended).
limits: No PDF/A-1b or -a (accessible) levels.

behavior: Choose PDF/A-3b (allows attachments).
The result lists rules not fixed, with ISO 19005 clause.
Choose 'Add text' and click on a page to place a text box.
limits: Only adds new text; cannot edit existing PDF text.

behavior: Type the selected box's text in the panel field; it updates on the page.
limits: Single-line field in the app (CLI supports \n).

behavior: Step text size through 4–200 pt with − / +.
limits: Helvetica only; no font choice, bold or italic.

behavior: Pick black, grey, red or blue swatch.
limits: Four colours only; no picker.

behavior: Choose 'Add image', pick a PNG/JPEG, then click a page to place it centred.
limits: PNG/JPEG only.

behavior: Choose Small (100 pt), Medium (150 pt) or Large (250 pt) image width.
limits: No free resize handles.

behavior: Click a placed text or image to select it.
Drag a placed item to move it; it stays on its page.
limits: Cannot drag an item to another page.

behavior: Click 'Remove text' / 'Remove image' to delete the selected item.
limits: No undo.

behavior: Panel shows item count and why it cannot run (empty box, undrawable character).
limits: Non-Latin characters refused (Helvetica).

behavior: (Not implemented) no highlight, shapes, comments, whiteout or editing existing content.
limits: Edit: only text and images, no annotations.

behavior: Stamp page numbers on one or more PDFs.
Choose Single page or Double-sided (mirrored on even pages).
Tick 'First page is cover page' to skip numbering it.
Pick one of six top/bottom positions on the page grid.
Choose Small, Recommended or Big margin.
Type From page / To page to number only part of a single PDF.
limits: Ignored with several PDFs (all pages numbered).

behavior: Type the first number shown.
Choose number only, 'Page {n}', 'Page {n} of {p}' or Custom.
limits: No font, size or colour choice in the app (CLI has --font-size).

behavior: Type a custom template with {n} and {p}; errors are validated live.
Choose 'Place Text', type the text and font size.
limits: Font fixed; no bold/italic.

behavior: Pick Black, Grey, Red or Blue.
limits: Four colours (CLI accepts any RRGGBB).

behavior: Choose 'Place Image' and pick a PNG/JPEG.
Pick one of nine positions on the grid.
Choose Over the content or Below the content.
Tick Mosaic to tile the mark across the page.
Choose No, 25%, 50% or 75% transparency.
Type From/To page on a single PDF.
limits: Ignored for several PDFs; no live preview of the watermark.

behavior: Choose 'All pages' and type margins to cut in mm.
Choose 'Selected pages' and type which pages.
Choose 'Remove crop' to show full pages again.
Type top, bottom, left, right margins (decimal comma accepted).
limits: No drag-a-box crop on the page.

behavior: Page 1 previews with cut margins dimmed and kept area outlined.
limits: Preview shows page 1 only.

behavior: Choose Type and enter your full name; it is drawn in a script font.
limits: One script font; character limit MAX_SIGNATURE_CHARS.

behavior: Choose Draw and draw with the mouse on the pad.
limits: No pen colour or thickness choice.

behavior: Click Clear under the pad.
Choose Upload and pick a PNG/JPEG signature; bad images are refused at once.
limits: No background removal.

behavior: The panel previews the typed or uploaded signature.
Choose Small (100 pt), Medium (150 pt) or Large (220 pt).
limits: No free resize.

behavior: Click on a page to place the signature centred there.
limits: One signature per run; cannot place on several pages.

behavior: Click elsewhere or drag to move it.
Panel shows 'Placed on page N'.
Tick 'Use a certificate (.p12)', choose the file and password to sign digitally.
limits: No timestamp server, no signature validation view.

behavior: Type optional Reason and Location for the certificate signature.
A protected PDF added to Sign is refused: 'Unlock the PDF first, then sign it'.
(Not implemented) no initials, date or form fill.
limits: No fill-in of form fields, no request-signature flow.

behavior: Type and repeat a password and run Protect (AES-256).
Optionally type a separate owner password.
limits: Permissions are always 'all'; no print/copy restrictions.

behavior: Button stays disabled until both passwords match.
limits: No strength meter or show-password toggle.

behavior: Protect several PDFs with the same password.
Add protected PDFs, type each password when asked, and save unprotected copies.
limits: Only for PDFs you know the password of.

behavior: Tools that drop protection say 'The output is not password-protected.'
Type text and press Enter or Search to find all matches (case-insensitive).
limits: No regex or whole-word option.

behavior: Toggle Email, Phone number, Credit card, Date and SSN chips to search for them.
limits: Fixed set; no IBAN or custom patterns.

behavior: Matches list with checkbox, text and page; all checked by default.
Click a match's checkbox to keep it out of redaction.
Click a result row to scroll the viewer to that match.
Drag on a page to mark a rectangle for redaction.
Click 'Mark whole page N' to redact the current page.
limits: Only the current page; no page range in the app (CLI has --pages).

behavior: All marks list with label and page.
Click × on a marked item.
Click 'Clear all'.
limits: No undo.

behavior: After writing, Sheaf checks no searched text remains and reports it verified (also metadata, bookmarks, comments).
Notes list places where searched text remains (links, field names, fonts).
Info box reminds to review results before sending.
limits: No preview of the redacted output before saving; box colour fixed black.

behavior: Open a file into the Original slot and one into the Changed slot.
Dropped or multi-picked files fill empty slots in order.
Click 'Replace…' under a filled slot.
Click Swap between the slots.
Choose 'Semantic Text' to get a report PDF of word changes.
limits: Report is a new PDF; no in-app side-by-side view.

behavior: Choose 'Content Overlay' to get the changed PDF with changes highlighted.
Result counts added, removed, changed words and changed areas.
limits: No synchronized scrolling viewer.

behavior: In Redact, Sign and Edit, all pages show in a vertical scroll.
limits: Viewer only exists inside Redact, Sign and Edit; no standalone reader.

behavior: A left strip shows page thumbnails; the current page is outlined.
Click a thumbnail to scroll to that page.
Click − to step zoom down.
limits: Min 50%.

behavior: Click Fit to return to 100% (fit width).
limits: No fit-page mode.

feature: Zoom in the page viewer with Cmd+
behavior: Press Cmd+ (or Cmd=) to zoom in.
limits: Only after clicking into the viewer (focus).

behavior: Press Cmd− to zoom out.
Press Cmd0 to fit width.
Zooming keeps the same part of the document in view.
limits: No pinch or Ctrl+scroll zoom.

behavior: Current zoom shows between − and +.
Only pages near the viewport render; cache limited to 96 MB.
'Opening…' or an error shows while loading.
(Not implemented) no outline/TOC panel, no find-in-document, no page number entry.
limits: Viewer has no outline/TOC panel, no Ctrl+F, no go-to-page, no keyboard page navigation.

behavior: With 'Ask every time', a Save dialog with the default name opens for one output.
Multiple outputs (Split, PDF to JPG, batches) ask for a folder.
Outputs get suffixes like -merged, -compressed, -signed, -redacted.
An existing name gets ' (1)' instead of being overwritten.
Cancelling the Save dialog aborts the run silently.

feature: Run button enabled only when ready
behavior: The action button enables only when options are valid and files are ready.
While running, a progress bar with percentage covers the file area.
Click Cancel; 'Cancelling…' shows and written outputs are removed.
After a run, the tab shows output cards, a summary bar and 'Continue to…'.
Click the file icon on an output card to open it.
Click the folder icon on an output card to show it in Finder.
Click 'Open folder' to reveal the first output.
Click the start-over control to clear files and run the same tool again.
Click a tool under 'Continue to…' to open it with these outputs.
Files that failed in a batch are listed with their error.
Tool notes (PDF/A issues, redaction notes) show on the result page.
A failed job shows '<tool> failed: <error>' and the tab returns to editing.
If the fixed folder no longer exists, a toast says so and the Save dialog opens.
(Not implemented) no print or share actions.
limits: No print, share sheet or drag-out of results.

behavior: Tasks History lists every finished job (tool, files, when), newest first.
limits: Capped at 200 entries.

behavior: Click the folder icon on a row to show the output (disabled if missing).
Click 'Clear all' then confirm 'Clear the whole history?'.
Times show relatively and refresh when a Home page is shown.
(Not implemented) history rows cannot be re-run or filtered.
limits: No search, filter or re-run.

behavior: Choose System, Light or Dark.
SHEAF_THEME=dark|light forces appearance.
limits: Debug only.

behavior: Choose 'Ask every time' for a Save dialog each run.
Choose 'Save next to the original file'.
Choose 'Always save to a folder' and pick it with Choose….
Toggle the switch to reveal outputs after each job.
Preferences persist in prefs.json.
limits: No language, default compression or naming preferences.

behavior: sheaf merge a.pdf b.pdf -o out.pdf merges in order.
sheaf split --ranges 1-3,5 -o dir/ writes one file per range.
sheaf split --every N -o dir/ splits every N pages.
sheaf extract --ranges … -o out.pdf.
sheaf remove --pages … -o out.pdf.
sheaf organize --order 3,0,1 reorders, 0 inserts a blank page, repeats duplicate.
sheaf rotate --degrees 90|180|270|-90 [--pages] rotates.
sheaf compress --level low|recommended|extreme.
sheaf protect --user-password [--owner-password].
sheaf unlock with global --password.
sheaf repair rebuilds a damaged PDF.
sheaf to-jpg --dpi --quality 1-100 -o dir/.
sheaf from-images [--a4 [--landscape]] builds a PDF from images.
limits: Fixed 0.5 in margin with --a4.

behavior: sheaf number with --position, --double-sided, --cover, --margin, --from/--to, --start, --text, --custom, --font-size.
sheaf watermark --text|--image with font size/auto, RRGGBB colour, scale, position/mosaic, transparency, rotate, --below, range.
sheaf crop --top/--bottom/--left/--right mm, --pages, or --remove.
sheaf ocr [--language en] [--all-pages].
sheaf to-word [--ocr].
sheaf to-powerpoint [--ocr].
sheaf to-excel --layout one-sheet|sheet-per-table [--ocr].
sheaf compare old new --mode text|overlay.
sheaf redact --text (repeatable) --pattern email|phone|credit-card|ssn|date --pages.
limits: No rectangle areas by coordinates.

behavior: sheaf sign --page --at X,Y --width with --text|--image|--strokes JSON, optional --p12 --p12-password --reason --location.
sheaf edit with repeated --text/--image items each with --page --at --size --color --width.
sheaf pdfa --level 2b|3b; exit 1 if not conforming.
sheaf office converts Office/HTML via LibreOffice.
sheaf info prints pages, sizes, encryption, metadata, forms, bookmarks as JSON.
sheaf text [--pages] prints page text separated by form feeds.
sheaf render --page --dpi 18-600 -o page.png.
sheaf tools prints every command as JSON schema.
--password opens every protected input.
limits: One password for all inputs.

behavior: --json prints {ok, outputs, notes, data} or {ok:false,error,code}.
Exit code 2 when a password is missing or wrong.
The CLI ships inside the app bundle (Helpers/sheaf, sheaf-cli.exe, bin/sheaf).
limits: Not added to PATH automatically.

behavior: sheaf mcp serves every command as an MCP tool over stdio.
limits: stdio only; no resources or prompts.

behavior: Tools are generated from the CLI with JSON schemas (tools/mcp/help skipped).
The edit tool takes an items array of text/image objects.
render returns the page PNG as image content so agents can look.
Each tool accepts a password argument (except from-images and office).
initialize returns instructions: never overwrites, read outputs, use info/text/render.
README shows 'claude mcp add sheaf -- …/sheaf mcp'.

feature: Open a file from Finder Open With
behavior: Choose Sheaf in Finder's Open With (or drop on Dock icon); PDFs go to Home to pick a tool.
limits: Registered as Alternate viewer; non-PDFs skipped with a toast.

behavior: Passing file paths to the app opens them like Open With.
Files arriving before the window is ready are queued and delivered in order.
Non-PDF or missing files show 'Not a PDF' / 'File not found' or a count.
Native builds for macOS arm64, Windows x64, Linux x64.
limits: macOS ad-hoc signed, not notarized; Windows unsigned; no Intel Mac build.

behavior: Everything runs locally, no upload or telemetry.
(Not implemented) no app menu commands or global shortcuts (Cmd+O, Cmd+W).
limits: Only viewer zoom shortcuts exist.

behavior: Window uses the app icon on Windows and Linux.
